body.name: \(\mathcal H_n\)
body.construction: On the binary-treatment inference submodel \(\mathcal A=\{d,e\}\), whose fixed grid therefore satisfies \(d_j\in\{d,e\}\) for every \(j\in\mathcal J\), define \(\mathcal H_n=\{(p,\omega):p=(\pi_j)_{j\in\mathcal J},\ \omega=(\omega_j)_{j\in\mathcal J},\ \pi_j\ge0,\ \sum_{j\in\mathcal J}\pi_j=1,\ 0\le\omega_j\le\pi_j,\ |\pi_j-\widehat p_j|\le\eta_n,\ |\omega_j-\widehat\omega_j|\le\eta_n\text{ for every }j\in\mathcal J\}\)
